# Claude AI iOS App with Opus 4 Model

## Official Claude iOS App

Yes, there is an official **Claude by Anthropic** iOS app available on the App Store [1]. The app was launched in May 2024 and provides access to Claude's AI capabilities directly on iPhone and iPad devices [2][3].

## Claude Opus 4 Availability

Claude Opus 4 is Anthropic's most advanced AI model, described as "the world's best coding model" with superior performance on complex tasks and AI agent workflows [4][5]. The model was introduced in May 2025 and represents a significant advancement in AI capabilities [4].

### Key Features of Claude Opus 4:
- **Hybrid reasoning model** with extended thinking capabilities [4][5]
- **200K context window** for handling large amounts of information [5]
- **Superior coding and reasoning** performance [4]
- **AI agent workflows** and complex task handling [4][5]

## Free Trial and Pricing Structure

### Free Tier Limitations
The Claude iOS app is **free to download** and offers limited usage [1][6]:
- Free users get access to Claude Sonnet model (not Opus 4) [6]
- **Limited queries per day** for free users [6]
- No unlimited free trial for Opus 4 specifically [6]

### Paid Plans for Opus 4 Access
To access Claude Opus 4, you need a paid subscription [4][5]:
- **Pro Plan**: Provides access to Claude Opus 4 [1][6]
- **Max Plan**: Also includes Opus 4 access [4]
- **Team Plan**: Starting at $30/month per user (minimum 5 seats) [6]
- **Enterprise Plan**: For business users [5]

### API Pricing
For developers, Claude Opus 4 API pricing starts at [5]:
- $15 per million input tokens
- $75 per million output tokens

## App Features

The official Claude iOS app includes [1][2][3]:
- **Cross-device sync** - conversations sync between web and mobile
- **Image analysis** - upload photos for real-time analysis
- **File uploads** - documents can be uploaded for analysis
- **Vision capabilities** - camera integration for immediate image processing
- **Seamless integration** with your device's photo library

## Alternative Third-Party Apps

There are also third-party apps that claim to offer Claude AI functionality [7][8], but these are not official Anthropic products and may have different pricing structures and limitations.

## Summary

While there is an official Claude iOS app that's free to download, **unlimited access to Claude Opus 4 requires a paid subscription** - there is no free trial offering unlimited Opus 4 usage [1][4][6][5]. Free users are limited to the Sonnet model with daily query restrictions [6].
